title: ലിംഗപദവി: സൈദ്ധാന്തിക സമീപനങ്ങൾ
journal: Indian Journal of Malayalam Language Research Studies - സംസ്‌കൃതി
abstract: ജീവശാസ്ത്രപരമായ വ്യത്യാസങ്ങളെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ലൈംഗികതയിൽ നിന്ന് വ്യത്യസ്തമായി, ലിംഗപദവി എന്നത് പൂർണ്ണമായും പിതൃമേധാവിത്വ സമൂഹം സൃഷ്ടിച്ചെടുത്ത സാമൂഹ്യനിർമ്മിതിയാണെന്നത് ഫെമിനിസ്റ്റ് ചിന്തയുടെ അടിസ്ഥാനബോധ്യങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നാണ്. പുരുഷന് സമൂഹത്തിൽ മേൽക്കോയ്മ നൽകാനും സ്ത്രീകളെ അധികാരശ്രേണിയിൽ താഴെ നിർത്താനും ഈ സങ്കല്പം കാരണമായിട്ടുണ്ട്. ലിംഗപദവി എന്നത് മനുഷ്യന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനപരമായ തെരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പല്ല, മറിച്ച് ഭാഷയിലൂടെയും സംസ്കാരത്തിലൂടെയും അധികാര ഘടനകളിലൂടെയും നിരന്തരം അടിച്ചേൽപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ഒന്നാണിത്. യഥാർത്ഥ വിമോചനം സാധ്യമാകണമെങ്കിൽ സമൂഹത്തിൽ ആഴത്തിൽ വേരൂന്നിയ ഈ പുരുഷാധിപത്യ വാർപ്പുമാതൃകകളെ പൂർണ്ണമായി പൊളിച്ചെഴുതുകയും സ്വന്തം ശരീരത്തിന്മേലും അസ്തിത്വത്തിന്മേലുമുള്ള അവകാശം തിരിച്ചുപിടിക്കുകയും വേണം . ലിംഗപദവിയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആധുനികമായ ചിന്തകളുടെ കേന്ദ്ര ആശയത്തെ പരിചയപെടുത്തുകയാണ് ഈ പഠനത്തിന്റെ ലക്‌ഷ്യം .

WHO WANTS TO WATCH THE ADVERTISEMENTS? THEY WANT TO SEE THE UNSEEN, THE EXISTING EMOTION THAT IS NOT PRESENT IN THE REAL SENSE
journal: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews
abstract: Normally, the meaning of "tabloid" is a newspaper with pages half the size of those of the average broadsheet, typically popular in style and dominated by sensational stories. However, who reads the newspapers? Are they the emotional advertisements that are played and watched as if real life had no emotions? Is social media an art, though it has no emotion, but a large community to connect with? What is an Emotion? Is it just a motion or a still where hearts melt at a sentiment, a path where fun and relaxation give it a complete memory? In reality, it is just a word chart, not real. No sentiment can create content, as in the end, it is the purchase that counts. A journey where one domain makes way for another: this is the curious world of advertising, where emotions are measured and weighed with words to allure the target audience and delete the real feeling for the reel, while keeping the emotional ones at bay. This context concerns content on emotion in technology, which is reviewed in this article, drawing on prior literature, with the aim of understanding, in terms, whether sentiment is a feeling or a mirrorless tabloid whose value is weighed only in reel terms.

title: WHEN CORRECT CODE IS NOT ENOUGH: ASSESSING THE PRODUCTION READINESS OF LLMGENERATED SOFTWARE
journal: International Journal of Software Engineering & Applications
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate executable software, but functional correctness alone does not establish production readiness. This study evaluates GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna across 15 algorithmic and production-oriented tasks using five generations per model-task pair, yielding 225 generated programs plus 15 fixed references. The layered testbed combines nominal and hidden-edge-case checks, moderate and severe production-like stress, metamorphic validation, reference-normalized runtime and memory, structural quality, static analysis, implementation-strategy inspection, and generation cost. All 800 functional and 368 applicable robustness checks passed, while production-stress success fell to 95.16% for Sol, 95.60% for Terra, and 93.38% for Luna. Cross-model stress differences were not significant, but generation cost differed strongly. A Quick Sort case showed more than a 500x runtime spread among behaviorally correct implementations. The results show that production-oriented evaluation must extend beyond pass/fail correctness to include stress behavior, resources, implementation strategy, and cost

title: The Ambient Room Temperature Physics & Decision Patience in Psychology : Introducing The Supradip's Thermo-Patience Parameter ( S_tp ) — With Analysis and Significance
journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH IN ENGINEERING AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: The Human decision-making, emotional patience, and sustained concentration do not occur in isolation; they are continuously influenced by the surrounding physical environment, particularly the thermal energy of a room. In daily life, when ambient room temperature rises too high or drops too low, people experience faster mental fatigue, lower frustration tolerance, and a higher tendency to make hurried, impulsive choices rather than persisting through difficult cognitive tasks. Despite this well-known connection between Physics and the human Psychology, there has been actually no simple, unified ratio parameter that directly measures how much cognitive patience a person retains under varying thermal discomfort. To bridge this gap between these things, this fully SOLO research introduces The Supradip's Thermo-Patience Parameter ( S_tp ), a dimensionless 0-to-1 ratio defined as the Patience Factor or Patience Ratio ( P_r ) divided by the Thermal Discomfort Factor ( D_f ) , written simply as S_tp = P_r / D_f . This research work is done Fully SOLO , within record-making time duration of approximately 4 hours totally (Or actually it is you can say, well within one day, i.e. , 24 hours obviously , it is even less than 4 hours approximately) . The 'S_tp' reaches its maximum value of 1 at ideal thermal comfort ( approximately at 23 °C) and drops progressively toward 0 as ambient room temperature deviates into extreme heat or cold. Whatever, this research is mainly/ primarily about Psychology. This parameter gives students, educators, and workplace planners a straightforward tool to optimize indoor temperature for maximum patience, deeper concentration, and calmer decision-making here.

title: Slope-Based Land Suitability Mapping For Local Food Diversification In Pasuruan Regency
abstract: This study maps slope-based land suitability as preliminary information for local food-diversification planning in Pasuruan Regency, East Java, Indonesia. A descriptive spatial approach was used to process topographic and administrative data in a geographic information system. Terrain was classified into five slope categories and overlaid with administrative boundaries to describe its distribution across the regency and its 24 subdistricts. The resulting pattern shows that flat and gently sloping terrain is concentrated in the north and northeast, whereas moderately steep to very steep terrain is more common in the south and west. These conditions suggest that areas with fewer topographic constraints may be considered for further assessment of seasonal food crops and horticulture, while steeper areas may be better directed toward perennial crops, agroforestry, and conservation. The spatial findings were interpreted alongside official information on local crop production, poverty, and child nutrition. Production statistics indicate an existing base of maize, roots and tubers, and vegetables, but do not establish household dietary patterns or food access. Because slope was the only biophysical criterion examined, the map is an initial planning reference rather than a comprehensive land-suitability assessment. Further assessment should incorporate soil, water, land cover, tenure, and accessibility conditions.

title: Quantifying abdominal abscess burden using area under the curve methods inspired by dehiscence, infection/inflammation, seroma, hematoma classification
abstract: BACKGROUND Postoperative intra-abdominal abscesses remain a common complication of abdominal surgery and are associated with prolonged treatment and delayed recovery. Although the Clavien-Dindo (CD) classification is widely used to grade postoperative complications, patients with the same CD grade may experience substantially different clinical courses. Inspired by the intervention framework of the dehiscence, infection/inflammation, seroma, hematoma classification system, we developed an area under the curve (AUC)-based approach to quantify the cumulative treatment burden. AIM To evaluate the utility of an AUC-based measure of the cumulative burden and factors associated with postoperative intra-abdominal abscesses abscess treatment. METHODS We retrospectively analyzed 59 patients with postoperative intra-abdominal abscesses. Treatment intensity was graded according to the level of intervention required for abscess management and integrated over time using an AUC-based approach. Patients were stratified into high- and low-AUC groups using the upper quartile (19.5) as the cutoff. RESULTS Diabetes mellitus (P = 0.016), greater intraoperative blood loss (P = 0.007), and abscess size ≥ 5 cm (P = 0.037) were associated with higher AUC values. CD grade III complications were more frequent in the high-AUC group than in the low-AUC group (P < 0.001). Despite this association, substantial variation in the treatment burden remained within individual CD grades, with patients in the high-AUC group requiring significantly longer treatment courses and hospital stays. CONCLUSION This AUC-based approach identifies clinically meaningful variations in treatment burden that are not captured by CD grade alone.

title: Perturbative Approach to Nonlinear Capacitance Matrix Formulations
abstract: Abstract We study a nonlinear Helmholtz system with cubic nonlinearity on high-contrast inclusions in three dimensions, and the solitons that emerge as the contrast $$\delta $$ δ tends to zero. Using the Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator and a capacitance formalism, we develop a perturbative cascade that expands the resonant frequency and field in powers of $$\sqrt{\delta }$$ δ . Our main result is a rigorous two-way correspondence with a finite discrete nonlinear capacitance system: every discrete solution lifts to a continuous soliton (a convergent expansion, analytic in $$\sqrt{\delta }$$ δ ), and every continuous family with the natural subwavelength scaling reduces to a discrete one. The construction is algorithmic, giving higher-order corrections in both the subwavelength and non-subwavelength regimes, the latter via a frequency-dependent capacitance matrix and in powers of $$\delta $$ δ . We illustrate the theory numerically by evaluating the accuracy of the perturbative approach and characterise symmetry-breaking bifurcations in symmetric dimers.
